text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nguaaaaaaahhh...!!!!
To think that on my tender skin, a pimple has...!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Did I eat too many steamed buns?! Or was it the cola?!
...No, this is no time to be worrying about that!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: If a pimple appears, I shall conquer it with skincare!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
First is washing our faces!! I don't really get it,
but let's just try everything one by one!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason sprang into action with all her might
to treat her breakout-prone skin.
